description: Recommend a gameserver or VPS plan from the user's needs (game, players at the same time, mods; or what runs on the VPS) with the shop's sizing logic. Returns the recommended configuration, alternatives and orderRequest, the exact arguments for preview_order and create_checkout_link. Works without sign-in. Read-only: nothing is ordered.

description.description: vserver: what will run on it, in the user's words (e.g. "Nextcloud for 10 people").

expectedPlayers.description: gameserver: players online at the same time. Ask the user; without it the game's default is used.

gameSlug.description: gameserver: gameSlug from list_orderable_games, or the game's name (e.g. "Minecraft").

minCpuCores.description: Hard minimum CPU cores, only if the user states one.

minDiskGb.description: Hard minimum disk in GB, only if the user states one.

minRamGb.description: Hard minimum RAM in GB, only if the user states one.

mods.description: gameserver: none (vanilla), light (a few mods/plugins) or heavy (big modpacks, many plugins). Default none.

productType.description: gameserver: a server for one game. vserver: a VPS (website, bot, database, VPN, own software).

regionSlug.description: Location from list_orderable_product_regions; omit for the automatic choice.

name: recommend_plan
title: Recommend a Plan
